title: get api v1 health returns service status ok
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/health returns HTTP 200 with a response indicating the service status is ok and no authentication is required.

title: post api v1 auth register creates new client and issues verification otp
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/register with valid fullName, email, password, and consentAccepted true creates a new client user, returns HTTP 201 with public user data and verification message.

title: post api v1 auth verify email validates six digit otp
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email with valid email and six-digit code returns HTTP 200 with verified public user; invalid or expired codes return HTTP 400 with INVALID_VERIFICATION error.

title: post api v1 auth login authenticates verified user and sets session cookies
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/login with verified user credentials returns HTTP 200 with public user and session/CSRF cookies; invalid password returns 401 INVALID_LOGIN; unverified email returns 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.

title: post api v1 auth logout revokes session with valid csrf token
description: Test POST /api/v1/auth/logout with authenticated session and valid X-CSRF-Token returns HTTP 204 no content and revokes session; missing or invalid CSRF token returns 403 INVALID_CSRF.

title: post api v1 orders creates new order for verified client
description: Test POST /api/v1/orders with authenticated verified client, valid X-CSRF-Token, and required order data creates a new order, returns HTTP 201 with order reference and history; unverified or unauthenticated clients receive 403.

title: post api v1 orders orderid cancel cancels order when allowed
description: Test POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/cancel with authenticated client and valid X-CSRF-Token cancels the order if state allows, returns HTTP 204; repeated or invalid state cancellation returns 409 invalid transition.

title: get api v1 admin orders metrics returns order counts for admin
description: Test GET /api/v1/admin/orders/metrics with admin authentication returns HTTP 200 with counts of orders by workflow status; non-admin users receive 403 FORBIDDEN.

title: patch api v1 admin orders orderid assignment assigns active admin
description: Test PATCH /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/assignment with admin authentication, valid X-CSRF-Token, and assignedAdminId assigns or unassigns an active admin, returns HTTP 200 with assignment details; invalid data returns 400 INVALID_ASSIGNMENT.

title: post api v1 admin orders orderid status transitions order state legally
description: Test POST /api/v1/admin/orders/:orderId/status with admin authentication, valid X-CSRF-Token, and to status performs a legal state transition, returns HTTP 200 with transition receipt; illegal transitions return 409 INVALID_ORDER_TRANSITION.
